settings.question: How do I receive my digital downloads after purchasing?
settings.answer: Immediately upon checkout completion, you will receive an instant download page with direct links, plus an automatic confirmation email containing all access links, duplicate URLs, and video walkthrough guides.

settings.question: Do I need a paid Notion subscription to use Tazvella templates?
settings.answer: No! All Tazvella Notion templates are 100% compatible with the completely FREE personal Notion plan. Simply click Duplicate to save the dashboard to your workspace.

settings.question: Can I track multiple dogs or cats in the Pet Parent Sanctuary?
settings.answer: Yes! You can add unlimited dogs, cats, or small pets. Each pet receives an isolated health passport, vaccine alerts, and photo memory scrapbook.

settings.question: Which devices and apps support the digital iPad planners?
settings.answer: Our digital journals work on any tablet or device supporting PDF annotation: GoodNotes 5 & 6, Notability, Noteshelf, CollaNote, and Xodo.
